subject: Cloudridge vendor setup & privacy checklist — initial info needed
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Santos <elena.santos@cloudridge.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 14 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Cloudridge vendor setup & privacy checklist — initial info needed

Hi Elena —

Thanks for confirming Cloudridge as a Redwood vendor. We’re kicking off the procurement vendor-setup process and I wanted to get a few privacy/security items on the table so we can keep the timeline tight. Can you please share the following by EOD Wednesday (6/18) if possible: 

- Do you have a signed Master DPA available? If not, are you able to sign Redwood’s standard DPA (I can send) or provide your standard DPA for review?
- Current list of subprocessors (name, jurisdiction, purpose). A CSV or spreadsheet is ideal.
- Data retention policy for customer data processed on our behalf (retention periods, deletion policy).
- Evidence of SOC2 or an alternative compliance report (PDF summary or link).
- Billing & PO process: billing contact, remit-to details, whether a PO is required prior to first invoice.
- Any localization/data residency constraints we should know about for production deployments.

Attachments I’ll need from your side are usually: signed DPA, subprocessor spreadsheet, and SOC2 summary. We’ll route these to Procurement + Security for the intake.

For context I’ve looped in Laura (Procurement) and Priyom (Security). Once we have these pieces, Laura will create the vendor record and open a PROC ticket.

Thanks — quick answers here will help avoid hold-ups.

Regards,
Aditya Rao
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
(aditya.rao@redwood.ai)
(Attachment: Redwood_DPA_template.pdf)

From: Elena Santos <elena.santos@cloudridge.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Cloudridge Legal <legal@cloudridge.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 14 Jun 2025 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cloudridge vendor setup & privacy checklist — initial info needed

Hi Aditya —

Thanks for the list. Quick answers below and I’ve attached the files you asked for.

- DPA: We can sign Redwood’s standard DPA. I reviewed the template you attached and legal is comfortable with the majority of terms; we will sign and return.
- Subprocessors: Attached is the current subprocessor CSV (cloudridge_subprocessors_2025-06.csv). We perform processing in the US and EU and we use the subprocessors listed for logging, analytics, and hosting.
- Retention: Default customer data retention is 90 days for logs, indefinite for aggregated analytics (non-identifiable), and a 30-day backup retention window for operational recovery. We can discuss stricter retention for regulated customers.
- SOC2: Attached is our SOC2 Type II summary (Cloudridge_SOC2_Type2_Summary.pdf). Full audit report can be shared under NDA.
- Billing/PO: Billing contact is finance@cloudridge.com. They accept POs and provide net-30 terms after setup. Please direct PO to AP@cloudridge.com and CC finance@cloudridge.com.
- Residency constraints: We have an EU region offering and can discuss data residency if you plan to deploy to EU-only customers.

Attachments: Cloudridge_DPA_signed.pdf (we signed your DPA with minor signature metadata), cloudridge_subprocessors_2025-06.csv, Cloudridge_SOC2_Type2_Summary.pdf

Let me know if you want any of this reworded for your intake form. Happy to hop on a 20-minute call if helpful.

Best,
Elena Santos
Head of Partnerships
Cloudridge Inc.
(elena.santos@cloudridge.com)
(Attachment: Cloudridge_DPA_signed.pdf; cloudridge_subprocessors_2025-06.csv; Cloudridge_SOC2_Type2_Summary.pdf)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Santos <elena.santos@cloudridge.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Jun 2025 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cloudridge vendor setup & privacy checklist — initial info needed

Elena —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the attachments. I started the vendor onboarding ticket (PROC-789) and uploaded the files to the intake folder. A couple of clarifying items for our security intake: 

1) Subprocessor granularity: can you add a column for data categories processed by each subprocessor (e.g., logs, PII, analytics)? That helps our mapping.
2) Retention confirmation: you noted "90 days for logs" — is that configurable per customer or fixed? If configurable, can you point to the control and any SLA around deletion?
3) SOC2: we’ll request the full report under NDA; legal will send the NDA link once the ticket is live.

Marissa (Account Exec) — FYI on PO cadence; Elena indicated net-30 and accepts POs to AP@cloudridge.com. Please confirm if we need to escalate payment terms for the pilot.

Next steps: Elena to update subprocessor CSV, legal to finalize DPA (DocuSign link requested), then Procurement will finalize vendor record and enable billing.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Procurement Lead
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: PROC-789-intake-sheet.xlsx)

From: Elena Santos <elena.santos@cloudridge.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Cloudridge Legal <legal@cloudridge.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Jun 2025 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cloudridge vendor setup & privacy checklist — initial info needed

Hi Laura/Aditya —

Attached is an updated subprocessor file with a data-category column (cloudridge_subprocessors_2025-06.csv — v2) and our standard deletion workflow for configurable retention. I also re-attached the signed DPA; our legal routed the DocuSign envelope to Elena Santos (completed).

Summary of changes:
- Subprocessors file now includes: processor_name, country, service_description, data_categories, contact
- Retention controls: logs retention can be set per-customer during provisioning (default 90 days). Deletion requests are processed within 7 business days and we emit a deletion confirmation event to the customer contact.

Let me know if you want a short call to walk through the CSV. Otherwise, once Procurement confirms the vendor record we’ll expect the first PO and can enable billing.

Thanks,
Elena
(Attachments: cloudridge_subprocessors_2025-06_v2.csv; Cloudridge_DPA_signed.pdf)
